plain_description.what: Applies the split certificate (which compares a split with random splits) to structure known to exist: the 14 official MMLU-Pro categories over about 7,000 questions. No calls.
plain_description.why: An earlier test (G12) certified 0 of 60 tree splits, so this checks whether the certificate can certify anything at all, or whether it is simply blind.
plain_description.information: If the known categories failed too, G12's zero would be a sensitivity limit. If they pass, the certificate works at least at this scale. Result: the certificate clearly certifies the declared categories (statistic 0.108 against a random-split maximum of 0.042). That overturns the 'blind certificate' reading at whole-corpus scale. A later test (CERT-PC-SIZE) extended this to the smaller sizes of real tree splits. The test does not 'validate' the certificate in general.
